statement.zh: 第三千纪末哈布尔平原（含莱兰丘）城市体系因突发干旱而崩溃——此为 Weiss 等后续综合中的学术模型，本条不升为定论。
statement.en: That late-third-millennium Habur-plains urban systems (including Tell Leilan) collapsed because of abrupt drought is a scholarly model in later Weiss et al. syntheses; not elevated to fact here.

disclaimer: Hypothesis: climate-forced collapse remains debated; AJA 1990 is the 1985 excavation report, not by itself a settled climate verdict. Label as hypothesis; do not treat as proven sole cause.

editorial.notes: Paraphrased from cited registered sources only; density pass 3.
